versions.changelog:
haohuo-cps v1.0.7

- Removed duplicate/extra details in documentation and made instructions more concise.
- No changes to code or functionality; update is documentation only.
- Changelog clarifications: product info format and mandatory inclusion of promotion, commission rate, and link in recommended responses.
- Dropped mention of number of search results (was previously 5 per platform).

- Updated documentation and usage instructions in SKILL.md for clarity and thoroughness.
- Clarified command usage flow for product search, link conversion, and commission queries.
- Detailed formatting and requirements for presenting product and commission information to the user.
- Reinforced constraints for API Key handling and mandatory information display.
- Expanded supported scenarios and error handling guidance.
